rules.text: a CLOSED declared registry of nouns that are lexically feminine despite carrying none of the regular feminine markers (ة/اء/ى) -- membership is exact, never inferred from shape

a noun outside the registry never gets a shape-based vote here, whether it is masculine (قمر) or already regularly feminine-marked by ة (a DIFFERENT, morphological mechanism this pack does not decide)
growing the registry is a deliberate, reviewed pack edit -- never a runtime inference
